extension.summary: ABUKARIM TOOLS - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, and quick access to the ABUKARIM Wizard and its maintenance tools (Total Clean and old thumbnail cleanup). A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، ووصولاً سريعاً إلى معالج أبوكريم وأدوات الصيانة فيه (التنظيف الشامل وحذف الصور المصغّرة القديمة). كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.
extension.news: v3.2.10 - New toggle: AF3 waves while loading (turn off the wave animation behind the busy dialog, e.g. after picking a player). v3.2.9 - Backup/Restore no longer asks "Include my customisations?" - menus and widgets are always included. v3.2.8 - Device Tuning now really changes the cache (Kodi 21+ ignores advancedsettings cache); Restore Skin Profile lists your exports and can browse for any profile zip. v3.2.7 - Remote patches can run "once" per box (safe whole-file replacements). v3.2.6 - patches.json can now edit JSON files structurally (json_edit: match/set/unset/remove/append/insert/move) - e.g. fix a skinvariables node on every box remotely; Update Online Fixes applies them immediately. v3.2.5 - Dedicated icons for the 3.2 tools. v3.2.4 - FIX: AF3 power tray Force Close (ABUKARIM Wizard) was hidden although the wizard is installed - restored automatically on boot. v3.2.3 - FIX: AF2/AF3 menus that contained a hidden item failed to load or edit (Skin Variables error) - repaired automatically on boot. v3.2.2 - Remote Access showed http://Busy:8080 - the address now comes from the OS. v3.2.1 - Field fixes: QR screen is now a proper window (images showed blank, old screen bled through); preset list / patch checklist reopen when Kodi swallows them; OriginFix leaves Kodi system add-ons alone (stopped a 15 s rewrite loop). v3.2.0 - Remote patches/catalogs/presets from the Piers repo; skins.json sha256, companions, compatibility filters and per-skin Piers profiles (export/restore); menus hide items for missing add-ons; first-run presets, device cache tuning, per-box remote-access password, thin-build bootstrap; Share Log with QR. v3.1.20 - FIX: AF3 Auto Trailers stopped every trailer a split second after it opened (and retried every few seconds). The trailer now keeps playing while Kodi opens the stream. v3.1.19 - FIX: AF3 Auto Trailers switched itself on and off in a loop after the skin reload (and could reset its settings). The entry now runs once, reloads the skin only after its list closes, and saves safely. v3.1.18 - AF3 Auto Trailers: picking the Toggles entry now switches it ON straight away (then shows sound, delay and quality); pick it again and choose the first line to turn it off. v3.1.17 - AF3 Auto Trailers: the Toggles entry now shows On/Off, the trailer engine also starts from the AF3 Home screen when Kodi skips the ABUKARIM TOOLS service, and the log explains every step (focus, lookup, start). v3.1.16 - New in Toggles: AF3 Auto Trailers. Rest on a movie or show on the Arctic Fuse 3 Home or hubs and its trailer plays behind the page (straight from IMDb - no YouTube add-on, no account). Choose sound on/off, how long to wait (1-10 s) and 720p/1080p. Back and the footer ignore a playing trailer. v3.1.15 - Removed the DexSubtitles Auto-Download and Prism: TMDbHelper Play patches. The DexSubtitles background service added by older versions is removed automatically (restart Kodi once). v3.1.14 - AF3: Vertical Plot now also applies to the OSD seek bar info and the library views opened from the menus/sub-menus (plot scrolls vertically, smaller mini font, same spacing as Home). v3.1.11 - FIX: add-ons such as Arctic Fuse 3 could be linked to the wrong repository (one with an older version, so they never updated). Linking now picks the repository that carries your installed version, prefers the Piers repository on Kodi 22, corrects wrong links automatically, and refreshes the repositories when their saved listing is out of date. v3.1.10 - FIX: some add-ons (e.g. Arctic Fuse 3) stayed without an update source because Kodi did not start the ABUKARIM TOOLS background service. Opening ABUKARIM TOOLS now starts the service if it is not running and links add-ons to their repositories straight away. v3.1.9 - Rebuild Add-on Database is now hands-free: ABUKARIM TOOLS re-enables itself after the first restart and finishes the rebuild on its own. v3.1.8 - FIX: Rebuild Add-on Database now links your add-ons back to their repositories (update sources are saved before the rebuild and restored after it; the rest are matched after a repository refresh). Fix Add-on Update Origins also refreshes the repositories first on a fresh database. v3.1.7 - FIX: the background service was switched off again, so patches were not re-applied at boot and the boot-time repo linking never ran; it is back on. Finishing an add-on database rebuild from the menu no longer freezes the menu. v3.1.6 - Clearer Rebuild Add-on Database instructions: after the first restart, enable ABUKARIM TOOLS in My add-ons and it finishes the rest. v3.1.5 - FIX: Rebuild Add-on Database could get stuck after the first restart. It now re-enables only the add-ons that were enabled before, puts your skin back, and cannot get stuck in a loop. v3.1.4 - FIX: the ABUKARIM Wizard was reported as not installed even when it was. v3.1.3 - The built-in OpenWizard was removed; the Maintenance menu now opens the ABUKARIM Wizard, and Total Clean / Clear Old Thumbnails run through it (offers to install the wizard if it is missing). v3.1.0.31 - FIX: the Node Icons toggle had no title in the Toggles menu. v3.1.0.30 - FIX: Node Icons toggle crashed (its texts were missing). TinyPPI fonts patch works with the newer TinyPPI (no more "1 failed" on every sweep). No more "Unknown addon id" errors in the log for add-ons that are not installed. v3.1.0.29 - New icons for "Setup & Install" and "Fix Add-on Update Origins"; DPlex toggle icon shows again; background service re-enabled and Skin/Add-on Portal installs patch immediately again; unused files, code and strings removed. v3.1.0.28 - AF3: Vertical Plot (Home) - the plot now sits a little lower, with more space under the genre line (ratings row unchanged). Patches that change the active skin now reload it automatically (waits until playback ends, no dialog is open and first-run is finished). v3.1.0.27 - FIX: auto-patching works again - the background service (watchdog) was disabled in addon.xml; Skin Portal and Add-on Portal installs now patch immediately. v3.1.0.26 - New patch toggle "AF3: Highlight Genre & Widget Titles": the Genre plotline and all widget titles use the skin highlight colour. v3.1.0.25 - AF3: Vertical Plot (Home) now also shows the Home plot in the smaller mini font (font_mini_plot); plot font elsewhere unchanged. v3.1.0.24 - New patch toggle "AF3: Vertical Plot (Home)": the Arctic Fuse 3 Home plot scrolls vertically like AF2 instead of horizontally. v3.1.0.23 - Add-on Portal auto-answers every "Add-on required / enable?" prompt during and just after installing (POV re-enables itself from its own service). v3.1.0.22 - No more "Add-on required / enable this add-on?" popups after installing from the Add-on Portal or Skin Selection - add-ons are enabled silently. v3.1.0.21 - Fix: Run First-Time Setup did nothing in 3.1.0.20 (script launched without add-on context); now launched via RunPlugin. v3.1.0.20 - First-run: welcome splash removed; steps no longer overlap (auto-patch sweeps pause during setup, setup runs detached from the menu, swallowed dialogs are re-shown instead of being treated as Skip). v3.1.0.19 - First-run setup now opens the Add-on Portal after the restore step (before patches and Skin Selection); Back skips it. v3.1.0.18 - Skin Selection redesigned: repository picker is now three large neon cards, and the skin gallery shows a live details panel (preview, name, installed state) beside a 3-column screenshot grid. v3.1.0.17 - New Add-on Portal (Setup & Install): tick any of 9 video add-ons (Dex Hub, DPlex, Fen Light+, Last Played, POV, Red Light, Seren, Umbrella, YouTube) and install them from their pinned repositories, with repos, dependencies and update origin handled automatically. v3.1.0.16 - Backup Manager: addon_data/plugin.program.abukarimtools is now excluded from both backup and restore (older backups that contain it are skipped on restore). v3.1.0.15 - Fix Kodi freezing when opening the add-on (TinyPPI fonts.py regex).
